root: ^Look what I found! A labyrinth! I just couldn’t wait any longer, so I came to explore myself. There’s something about this place that just... calls to me!

^She leans forward slightly, her voice filled with eagerness. But, uh... it’s dark inside, and I heard strange noises. She starts to sweat. So, I’ll wait out here for you. You’ve got to go in though, right? There’s got to be something important in there!
^She starts to look around her pockets, suddenly realizing something. Oh! My handkerchief! I must’ve left it somewhere... But, no matter! We’ve got bigger things to focus on!
^She smiles brightly, almost bouncing on her feet as she continues. This is so exciting. I feel like we’re really close to something big!
